label: preparing
what: Preparing bread and hall hospitality for an evening gathering described as the hospitality committee; innkeeper says the committee is builder, freight, and innkeeper. Bread deliveries were coordinated and reserved for the gathering. Baker and neighbour also knowingly helped with the bread/baking effort, though the record does not establish they were committee members. The mayor was not told the actual purpose or committee identities ahead of time; he did know of an appointment with the innkeeper and that bread deliveries existed.
